title: Cilia, Mucus and Mucociliary Interactions Conference
level: Scientists and graduate students (bachelor's degree in science/engineering required)
about: The 2027 Gordon Research Conference "Cilia, Mucus and Mucociliary Interactions" will take place from 14 to 19 February 2027 at Renaissance Tuscany Il Ciocco in Barga, Italy. Applications must be submitted by 17 January 2027 through the conference page on grc.org.
requirements: Undergraduates or those without a bachelor's degree in science/engineering (or acceptable equivalent) are not eligible to apply (GRC policy)
card_alt: Card for "Cilia, Mucus and Mucociliary Interactions Conference" by Gordon Research Conferences in Barga, Italy; application deadline 17 Jan 2027. The photo shows the Colosseum in Rome, not Barga.
